# ResultPortal.online

> Free online exam result portal for schools, madrasas, colleges and coaching centers. Schools upload student marks via Excel/CSV/Google Sheets and instantly get a branded public portal at resultportal.online/results/{school-slug} where students and parents check results by roll number or name — no signup, no app install required. Includes printable branded PDF marksheets (DMC) in 5 template styles.

ResultPortal.online is a multi-tenant SaaS platform primarily used in Pakistan, India, Bangladesh and Ethiopia. It offers 22+ portal designs (Neon, Luxury Gold, Glassmorphism, Minimalist, Cyberpunk, Kawaii, Islamic, Corporate, Nature, Royal Purple, etc.), a Free Forever plan with unlimited students, and a Pro plan ($20/month) that removes ads and unlocks all designs, branded PDFs, password-protected exams and countdown timers.

## What it does (feature list)

- Publish unlimited student exam results online (free forever)
- Upload data from Excel (.xlsx, .xls), CSV or Google Sheets with smart column auto-mapping
- 22+ pre-built portal designs, each with its own theme and branding
- Custom slug URLs like `resultportal.online/results/your-school-name`
- Search by roll number, student name or fuzzy match (configurable per school)
- Printable branded PDF marksheet (DMC) with 5 template styles: Classic, Modern, Elegant, Compact, Premium
- Multi-exam support with individual Start/Stop toggles and countdown timers
- Real-time result publishing (no page refresh needed)
- Class-based subject management with per-class grading
- Mobile-first responsive design — works on any phone
- Urdu language support (RTL) on the school dashboard
- Referral program: 10% commission in PKR on paid credits, JazzCash/Easypaisa withdrawal
- Admin dashboard with analytics, credit tracking and student management
- WhatsApp support and built-in AI chat assistant

## Who it is for

- Primary schools, high schools, matric and FSC colleges
- Madrasas and Islamic academies (Deeni Madaris)
- Universities and higher education institutions
- Coaching centers, tuition centers and academies
- Boards and entrance-test organizers publishing merit lists

## Pricing

- **Free Forever**: Unlimited students, unlimited exams, basic themes, WhatsApp support. No credit card required.
- **Pro — $20 / month (~5,600 PKR)**: All 22+ premium designs, branded PDF marksheets, no ads, password-protected exams, countdown timers, priority support.
- Contact via WhatsApp (+92 347 8312432) to upgrade.

## Why schools choose it

- Launches in minutes vs. weeks for a custom website
- Free vs. 30,000–100,000 PKR for a custom-built result system
- Students don't need to sign up or install anything
- Automatically mobile-friendly and shareable via WhatsApp/SMS
- Instant PDF marksheet download built in
